name: What is a one-bedroom ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: A one-bedroom ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) is a secondary housing unit on the same property as a single-family home, designed to be self-contained with a kitchen, bathroom, and a dedicated bedroom. These units are typically smaller than the primary residence and can serve various purposes, such as housing for family members, rental income, or a home office. Understanding your specific needs, such as occupancy or desired rental income, is a key decision factor in determining the optimal size and features for your ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: A one-bedroom ADU is a self-contained secondary housing unit on a single-family property, featuring a kitchen, bathroom, and one bedroom.
